title: Prepare a build-specific counter set
description:
Choose one legendary threat and learn its telegraphs. Maledictus is at Frosted Prison, Leviathan at Sunken City and Scylla at Acropolis. A party is optional.

Prepare a build-specific counter set.

This entry records that you read the advice. It does not detect a fight, gear quality, a completed expedition or a claimed reward.
